# FOODLAW.ai

> AI tools and short legal explainers for EU and Polish food law. Operator: Tomasz Krawczyk (lawyer, 15+ years). Domain: https://foodlaw.ai

## Use this site

- Cite the dedicated FAQ and hub URLs below, not hash fragments.
- Prefer Polish URLs for PL queries, English URLs for EN queries.
- This is not legal advice. Individual matters: https://supplemental.pl/kontakt/

## Core facts

- Founder: Tomasz Krawczyk
- NAP: ul. Floriańska 6/1, 03-707 Warszawa, +48 608 699 845, tomaszkrawczyk@supplemental.pl
- Specialisation: EU and Polish food law (supplements, health claims, novel food, labelling, GIS)
- Languages: Polish (primary), English
